items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I heard later that Fletcher Henderson went to Pittsburgh and hired all Pittsburghers with Art Blakey and they got angry with him when he was on his way to Chicago and when he reached the job where he was going, he had no band! So I was kind of glad to get out of that.

ctx.x: What sort of a man was he?

He was the kind of a man that he loved me so much he would almost put his own kids aside for me, if I needed anything. Well, he was very charitable. Sometimes I'd bring kids in that didn't have shoes and he'd give them money to buy shoes or to buy clothing. Fletcher had a big coat - this is funny - he had a big oversized coat made and he took me in gambling joints and everywhere and he'd put me under this coat because.... (NOT CLEAR) He was considered a very good, bad man, not overbearing but he was treacherous…
